step1_analysis.description: A wide-swing cascode current mirror operational transconductance amplifier (OTA), utilized as a voltage comparator for an active pixel sensor. It features a PMOS differential pair and cascode current mirrors to achieve high gain and precise integration time detection.

paper_reference.title: Novel CMOS Image Sensor With a 132-dB Dynamic Range

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the OTA

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. gm ~ 100uS, Rout ~ 100M ohm (due to cascodes). Gain ~ 10,000 = 80 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact bias currents and channel length modulation (lambda) of SKY130 devices at L=0.5um.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm / (2 * pi * CL). gm ~ 100uS, CL = 100fF. UGBW ~ 159 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales directly with the transconductance of the input pair and inversely with load capacitance.

Phase_Margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at output, non-dominant poles at mirror nodes. With 100fF load, PM should be > 45 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current mirror OTAs typically have good phase margin if the internal mirror poles are kept at high frequencies.

Power_Consumption.description: Total static power dissipation of the comparator

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 14mW for the entire image sensor chip. A single comparator block consumes tens of microwatts.

Propagation_Delay.description: Time delay from input crossing threshold to output crossing VDD/2

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on input overdrive voltage, tail current, and load capacitance.

Slew_Rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to tail current and inversely proportional to load capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC open-loop gain/phase, and Transient propagation delay/slew rate. Uses a massive RC filter to close the loop for DC/AC (preventing saturation) while acting as an open-loop comparator during fast transients.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Comparator / Folded Cascode OTA

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N6 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N5 LABEL_NET_3 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 LABEL_NET_4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N7 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N5 LABEL_NET_5 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Biases
VBIAS_TAIL LABEL_NET_1 0 1.2
VBIAS_PCAS LABEL_NET_3 0 0.6
VBIAS_NCAS1 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.2
VBIAS_NCAS2 LABEL_NET_5 0 1.2

* Inputs
* INP is LABEL_NET_2
VINP LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.8 1.0 50n 1n 1n 200n 400n)

* INN is LABEL_NET_0. Biased at 0.9V through massive RC for open-loop AC/Tran, closed-loop DC.
R1 N5 LABEL_NET_0 1G
C1 LABEL_NET_0 0 1G

* Load
CL N5 0 100f

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N5)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N5))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugbw

  * 3. Transient Analysis
  tran 100p 500n
  * Rising edge measurements (td=10n ignores t=0 initialization)
  meas tran t_pd_rise trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=1 td=10n targ v(N5) val=0.9 rise=1 td=10n
  meas tran t_rise trig v(N5) val=0.36 rise=1 td=10n targ v(N5) val=1.44 rise=1 td=10n
  let sr_r_V_us = 1.08 / t_rise * 1e-6

  * Falling edge measurements (td=100n ignores first edge)
  meas tran t_pd_fall trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 fall=1 td=100n targ v(N5) val=0.9 fall=1 td=100n
  meas tran t_fall trig v(N5) val=1.44 fall=1 td=100n targ v(N5) val=0.36 fall=1 td=100n
  let sr_f_V_us = 1.08 / t_fall * 1e-6

  print dc_gain ugbw pm t_pd_rise t_pd_fall sr_r_V_us sr_f_V_us
  quit
.endc
